scope: CPU only. Two fixed original reset witnesses F1-01 and F1-02, first in each verified startup cluster. Known reference only, no model actions.
path: Hold original accepted world reference for 1 s. For 4 s trace one X/Z circle using a minimum-jerk angular clock 0..2pi. Rotate about world Y with the sine of this same angle, then park at starting pose for 2 s. Old fixed mount and actually consumed open gripper.
rates: SLOW: peak linear 4 mm/s and angular 0.6 deg/s; SOURCE_SPEED: 11.25 mm/s and 0.045 rad/s. Radius and tilt amplitude selected analytically from peak clock speed. Check original H40/G7 at every 100 ms and native-scene kinematic sweeps at 50 ms. Iterate in registered order; preserve all failures.
limits: No new physical integration, no claims about WBC control, sensor noise, startup convergence or safety-stop behavior. Native permission and threshold/clearance remain independent.
